# Apex International School

> Apex International School is a CBSE-affiliated school in Odumbra, Olavanna, Kozhikode, Kerala, India, established in 2005.

## Key facts

- Affiliation: CBSE, New Delhi (Affiliation No. 930963)
- Mandatory Public Disclosure: https://apexinternationalschool.org/mandatory-public-disclosure
- Established: 2005
- Address: Odumbra, Olavanna P.O., Kozhikode, Kerala 673019, India
- Phone: +91 495 296 5004
- Email: info@apexinternationalschool.org
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/apexinternationalschoolclt/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@apexinternationalschool2179
- CBSE Class X (AISSE) 2025–26: 100% results; school topper Nehan Bin Shibil scored 99.6%
- All Kerala Kick Boxing Championship: Apex pupils won 1 gold and 3 silver medals
- Malabar Sahodaya District Kalotsav IT Fest: A grades in Digital Painting and PowerPoint Presentation
- Activities: Taekwondo, School Radio, Art and Craft, Skating and Chess

Fees, class availability, entry requirements and activity timetables are not published on the website. Families should confirm them with the school.

- [Home](https://apexinternationalschool.org/): Overview of the school, results and activities
- [About Apex](https://apexinternationalschool.org/about): Headmaster's welcome, why families choose Apex and pupil achievements
- [Results & Achievements](https://apexinternationalschool.org/results): CBSE Class X 2025–26 results, school toppers and perfect subject scores
- [News & Events](https://apexinternationalschool.org/news): School results, pupil achievements and events
- [Management](https://apexinternationalschool.org/about/management): Management Committee of Apex Educational Trust
- [Life at Apex](https://apexinternationalschool.org/life-at-apex): Activities beyond the classroom
- [Admissions](https://apexinternationalschool.org/apply-now): Start an admissions enquiry
- [Visit Us](https://apexinternationalschool.org/visit-us): Arrange a school visit and get directions
- [Contact Us](https://apexinternationalschool.org/contact-us): Phone, email, enquiry form and location
